players.product: Firefly / Acrobat AI Assistant / GenStudio AI creative and marketing applications

quarterly_data.signal: Q4 FY2026 targets given on the call: total Adobe revenue of $6.8 billion-$6.85 billion, business professionals and consumer subscription revenue of $1.93 billion-$1.95 billion, creative and marketing professional subscription revenue of $4.665 billion-$4.695 billion, non-GAAP EPS of $6.30-$6.35, non-GAAP operating margin of approximately 44%; interim CFO says the full-year raise is around $50 million at the midpoint, the Q3 beat was passed through net of a slight FX headwind into Q4, and the 10.2% ending-ARR growth guide was reiterated with Q4 net new ARR expected larger than Q3 (seasonally strong enterprise quarter)
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 FY2026 business professionals and consumer subscription revenue $1.93 billion-$1.95 billion; creative and marketing professional subscription revenue $4.665 billion-$4.695 billion; non-GAAP operating margin approximately 44%; full-year raise around $50 million at the midpoint

quarterly_data.signal: AI monetization scaling: CEO says AI-first ending ARR now exceeds $650 million and is growing more than 150% year-over-year; Firefly ending ARR across the Firefly app and Firefly credit packs grew 40% quarter-over-quarter, driven by intensity of AI usage (video in particular); credit consumption accelerating quarter-on-quarter across Creative Cloud and the Firefly app; Acrobat AI Assistant MAU doubled quarter-over-quarter
quarterly_data.figure: AI-first ending ARR exceeding $650 million, growing more than 150% year-over-year; Firefly ending ARR grew 40% quarter-over-quarter

quarterly_data.signal: Freemium user-acquisition strategy: Adobe products used by over 1 billion monthly active users (grew greater than 20% year-over-year in Q3); creative freemium MAU crossed 100 million, growing over 70% year-over-year; Acrobat plus Express MAU surpassed 900 million, growing more than 25% year-over-year; CEO says deferring Creative Cloud pricing actions in favor of new user adoption was the right call
quarterly_data.figure: creative freemium MAU crossed 100 million, growing over 70% year-over-year; Acrobat plus Express MAU surpassed 900 million, growing more than 25% year-over-year

quarterly_data.signal: RPO grew 8% year-over-year (single-digit growth); interim CFO says it reflects the continued execution against strategic initiatives and the focus on accelerating new user acquisition through the freemium model, is consistent with ARR trends, and that RPO and CRPO typically step up in the fourth quarter and then remain fairly flat over the next three quarters, with this year no different
quarterly_data.figure: RPO growing 8% year-over-year; CRPO growing 9% year-over-year

quarterly_data.signal: Agentic AI product ramp: Adobe Creative Agent expanded to Photoshop and Premiere; Adobe Productivity Agent powering new Acrobat features; CX Enterprise Coworker generally available in June with over 1,700 customers and early adopters; ending ARR growth of greater than 20% year-over-year for each of AEM and agentic web apps, Adobe GenStudio, and AEP and apps; paid customers for brand visibility solutions (Semrush AI Optimization combined with Adobe LLM Optimizer) doubled quarter-on-quarter; Adobe offers customers choice and intelligent routing across leading AI models
quarterly_data.figure: over 1,700 customers and early adopters of CX Enterprise Coworker; ending ARR growth of greater than 20% year-over-year for AEM and agentic web apps, GenStudio, and AEP and apps

quarterly_data.signal: Next catalysts: agreement to acquire Topaz Labs (AI enhancement models for imaging and video, over 1 million users) expected to close in Q4 subject to regulatory approvals; Adobe MAX in November in Miami Beach to showcase Creative Cloud, Firefly and Firefly for enterprise innovations; CEO transition with Anil Chakravarthy becoming President and CEO effective December 1st and Shantanu Narayen moving to Executive Chair

Firefly Enterprise expansion: Firefly Graph Enterprise Edition and Firefly Creative Production Enterprise Edition launched in July; Disney Imagineering integrating Firefly Foundry into its theme park design toolkit; expanded partnership with Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology and Humane to enable 27 million citizens and residents with Firefly and Express, including development of a new image generation model tuned to Saudi culture
quarterly_data.figure: 27 million citizens and residents (Saudi Arabia Firefly and Express enablement)
